name: Italian Core
orderingNote: Dictionary forms (infinitives for verbs, masculine singular for adjectives); nouns show their gender. Ordered by a blend of subtitle and web frequency, lemmatised; names, vulgar words and inflected forms removed. Ranks 5,001-10,000 extend the core in the same blended-frequency order with stricter filters (no participles or -mente adverbs of words already taught, no diminutives, place adjectives or clitic compounds).

sentences.translation: It seems you enjoy travelling the world.

sentences.translation: In my opinion he is not fit for the work.

sentences.translation: What school do you go to?

sentences.translation: Could you please repeat it slowly?

sentences.translation: Have a look around.

sentences.translation: Take a look in there.

sentences.translation: Why not try doing that?

sentences.translation: Try not to be late again tomorrow.

sentences.translation: Do you already know what to do?

sentences.translation: I really appreciate all your help.

sentences.translation: I'd really rather go alone.

sentences.translation: Get her away from here.

sentences.translation: Don't hurt my son.

sentences.translation: And does your son drive?

sentences.translation: I respect the mister's point of view.

sentences.translation: For what time, sir?

sentences.translation: Here's a good one for you.

sentences.text: Mi sento bene a fare qualcosa di buono.
sentences.translation: I feel nice doing something good.

sentences.translation: Maybe you could talk to her.

sentences.text: Forse vorresti andare con noi.
sentences.translation: Maybe you'd like to go with us.

cards.gloss: to bring; to carry; to take; to wear; to lead

sentences.translation: The child brings them to me.

sentences.translation: Nobody takes me anywhere.

sentences.translation: Do you happen to know his name?

sentences.translation: Don't mind her.

sentences.translation: Happy International Women's Day!

sentences.translation: What a strange woman!

sentences.translation: Could you please make room for me?

sentences.translation: I'm not going to your place.

sentences.translation: Have you ever seen anything so beautiful?

sentences.translation: Here's something we haven't seen before.

sentences.translation: Go ask your father.

sentences.translation: He asked me to speak more slowly.

sentences.translation: Don't look at me.

sentences.translation: I teach English to someone.

sentences.text: Qualcuno sta per morire.
sentences.translation: Somebody's going to die.

sentences.translation: Don't let the dog go.

sentences.translation: Are you seriously thinking about quitting your job?

sentences.translation: That's where the problem is.

sentences.translation: The doctor declared the patient dead.

sentences.translation: Let me speak first.

sentences.translation: Could you give me some help here?

sentences.translation: I hope I can be of some help to you.

sentences.translation: You will feel like the happiest person in the world.

sentences.translation: English is spoken everywhere in the world now.

sentences.translation: I promise to do my best.

sentences.translation: Go play outside.

sentences.translation: Don't come out here.

sentences.translation: Don't take that too literally.

sentences.translation: I'll let you get back to work.

sentences.translation: Don't call me again.

sentences.translation: Why can't you understand?

sentences.translation: I'll go to the library with you tomorrow.

sentences.translation: I'm not working with you today.

sentences.translation: Here's today's report.

sentences.translation: I'm not going to school today.

sentences.translation: I will go along with you as far as the station.

sentences.translation: Could you tell me how to get to the ballpark?

sentences.text: Che storia felice!

sentences.translation: Much work, little money.

sentences.translation: I wouldn't bet on it.

sentences.translation: The child brings them to me.

sentences.translation: As a child, I couldn't eat fish.

sentences.translation: We won't need any help until Monday.

sentences.translation: At the moment, I have no plans to travel.

sentences.translation: You don't even know us.

sentences.translation: I know her father, though I don't know her.

sentences.translation: Don't call here anymore!

sentences.translation: I'll call them for you.

sentences.translation: Our world is getting smaller and smaller.

sentences.translation: You don't need to be here tomorrow.

sentences.translation: Don't speak to him while he is driving.

sentences.translation: Don't put that in the bag.

sentences.translation: I have a lot to say against him.

sentences.translation: Here are some letters for you.

sentences.translation: Here's something to think about.

sentences.translation: Every language sees the world in a different way.

sentences.translation: I wasn't told a thing about it.

sentences.translation: Thanks to them, I got well at last.

sentences.translation: It is no use arguing with her.

cards.gloss: to enter, go in; to fit

sentences.translation: Tell him to let the dog in.

sentences.text: Non vi lasceranno entrare.
sentences.translation: They won't let you in.

sentences.translation: I remember meeting him somewhere.

sentences.translation: We'll be living there next month.

sentences.translation: A picture is worth a thousand words.

sentences.translation: Nothing about us, without us!

sentences.translation: Say nothing to him about the horse.

sentences.translation: Well, speak of the devil.

sentences.translation: Hard work doesn't always lead to success.

sentences.translation: Why won't you tell us?

sentences.translation: Don't attempt this at home.

sentences.translation: Let me try again.

sentences.translation: Hello, my friend!

sentences.translation: Why don't you just talk to them?

sentences.translation: Just talk with him.

sentences.translation: We will be safer here.

sentences.translation: He drives safely.

sentences.translation: I never work on weekends.

sentences.translation: If possible, this weekend.

sentences.translation: Don't use your real name.

sentences.text: Non usare troppo pepe.
sentences.translation: Don't use too much pepper.

sentences.translation: Try this instead.

sentences.translation: I saw him instead of his father.

cards.gloss: to stay, remain; to be left

sentences.translation: They told me to stay in the car.

sentences.translation: How long do you plan to stay in this country?

sentences.translation: I arrived just in time for the plane.

sentences.translation: For what reason?

sentences.translation: Here's what I don't get.

sentences.translation: Concerning this, I'm the one to blame.

sentences.translation: I won't see you today. I'll see you tomorrow anyway.

sentences.translation: I'll still go to the park even if it rains.

sentences.translation: Don't give them my number.

sentences.translation: I lost something very important to me.

sentences.translation: They add pictures to their album.

sentences.translation: Do you know the boy in the picture?

sentences.translation: I didn't have to go to work today.

sentences.text: Non lavoro più per lei.
sentences.translation: I don't work for her anymore.

sentences.text: Quando si mise a letto si addormentò subito.
sentences.translation: When he went to bed, he fell asleep right away.

sentences.translation: The clock that got broken must be repaired right away.

sentences.translation: I live together with my father and mother.

sentences.translation: Who drives better, your father or your mother?

sentences.translation: I would rather live alone in the country.

sentences.translation: I make a good living.

sentences.translation: If you continue like this, you'll always stay at the same point.

sentences.translation: Are you sure you want to continue doing this?

sentences.translation: Her husband is about to die.

sentences.translation: Don't let me die here.

sentences.translation: In an hour my child gets out of school.

sentences.translation: I would rather stay home than go out.

sentences.translation: Could you loan money to my brother?

sentences.translation: Don't give money to anyone.

sentences.text: Non faccio niente per cambiare.
sentences.translation: I don't do anything to change.

sentences.text: Non cambiare idea così spesso.
sentences.translation: Don't change your mind so often.

cards.gloss: to happen; to turn up; to come across; to end up

sentences.text: È capitato qualcosa di interessante a scuola oggi?
sentences.translation: Did anything interesting happen at school today?

sentences.text: Mi scuso per quello che è capitato qua.
sentences.translation: I apologize for what's happened here.

cards.gloss: by now; at this point; already

sentences.text: Ormai è alto quasi quanto suo padre.
sentences.translation: He is now almost as tall as his father is.

sentences.text: Il termometro ormai è il mio migliore amico.
sentences.translation: By now the thermometer is my best friend.

cards.gloss: to concern; to be about; to look over again

sentences.text: Questo non riguarda lei, vero?
sentences.translation: This doesn't concern you, does it?

sentences.text: Questo non riguarda il denaro.
sentences.translation: This isn't about money.

sentences.text: Andrò dal dottore questo pomeriggio.
sentences.translation: I will go to the doctor this afternoon.

sentences.text: Conoscete qualche bravo dottore?
sentences.translation: Do you know any good doctors?

sentences.text: Non avvicinarti troppo al fuoco.
sentences.translation: Don't go too near the fire.

sentences.text: Non giocare con il fuoco!
sentences.translation: Don't play with fire.

sentences.text: Non potete essere serie.
sentences.translation: You cannot be serious.

sentences.text: Non siete serie, vero?
sentences.translation: You're not serious, are you?

sentences.text: Non fare bagnare il telefono.
sentences.translation: Don’t get the phone wet.

sentences.text: Parlo con lei al telefono.
sentences.translation: I talk to her on the phone.

sentences.text: Non so nulla della loro relazione.
sentences.translation: I don't know anything about their relationship.

sentences.text: È mai stato in una relazione a distanza?
sentences.translation: Have you ever been in a long distance relationship?

sentences.text: Il debito nazionale sta crescendo.
sentences.translation: The national debt is growing.

sentences.text: Dobbiamo ridurre il debito nazionale.
sentences.translation: We have to reduce the national debt.

cards.gloss: to tell (a story); to recount; to narrate

sentences.text: Mi racconti di più del suo viaggio.
sentences.translation: Tell me more about your trip.

sentences.text: Ci racconti la storia dall'inizio alla fine.
sentences.translation: Tell us the story from beginning to end.

sentences.text: Un euro vale un dollaro e mezzo.
sentences.translation: One euro is one-point-five dollars.

sentences.text: L'ingresso al museo costa trenta dollari.
sentences.translation: Admission to the museum is thirty dollars.

sentences.text: Ho sempre odiato il freddo.
sentences.translation: I've always hated the cold.

sentences.text: Lasciatemi da solo! Vi odio!
sentences.translation: Leave me alone! I hate you!

cards.gloss: low; short (in height); (in basso) down, below

sentences.text: Firma in basso, per favore.
sentences.translation: Sign at the bottom, please.

sentences.text: Non guardare in basso.
sentences.translation: Don't look down.

cards.gloss: to allow; to permit; to enable

sentences.text: Vi permettono di indossare dei jeans in ufficio?
sentences.translation: Do they allow you to wear jeans to the office?

sentences.text: Il denaro ti permette di comprare qualsiasi cosa.
sentences.translation: Money enables you to buy anything.

sentences.text: Agente di polizia, io non ho fatto niente!
sentences.translation: Police officer, I didn't do anything!

sentences.text: Il mio vicino è un agente immobiliare.
sentences.translation: My neighbor is a realtor.

sentences.text: Vai a dormire adesso.
sentences.translation: Go to sleep now.

sentences.text: Mi piace leggere prima di andare a dormire.
sentences.translation: I like to read before going to sleep.

cards.gloss: to be worth; to be valid; to count; to apply

sentences.text: Quanto vale per lei?
sentences.translation: How much is it worth to you?

sentences.text: Non vale il rischio.
sentences.translation: It's not worth the risk.

sentences.text: Per piacere, compra questo per me.
sentences.translation: Please buy this for me.

sentences.text: Non mi comprare niente.
sentences.translation: Don't buy me anything.

cards.gloss: to win; to defeat; to overcome

sentences.text: Il primo premio potrebbe essere vinto da lui.
sentences.translation: The first prize may be won by him.

sentences.text: Merito di vincere.
sentences.translation: I deserve to win.

sentences.text: Che storia strana!
sentences.translation: What a strange story!

sentences.text: Che cane strano!
sentences.translation: What a strange dog!

sentences.text: Fui invitato al loro matrimonio.
sentences.translation: I was invited to their wedding.

sentences.text: Mi ha invitato a partecipare al suo matrimonio.
sentences.translation: He has invited me to attend his wedding.

sentences.text: L'uomo medio è più grande di me.
sentences.translation: The average man is bigger than I.

sentences.text: Non faccio parte della classe media.
sentences.translation: I'm not middle class.

sentences.text: Non sai parlare inglese, vero?
sentences.translation: You can't speak English, can you?

sentences.text: Sai tradurre dall'inglese al giapponese?
sentences.translation: Can you translate English into Japanese?

sentences.text: Non capisco l'opera.
sentences.translation: I don't get opera.

sentences.text: Chi compra questo genere di opere d'arte?
sentences.translation: Who buys this type of art?

sentences.text: È vietata la discriminazione sulla base del sesso.
sentences.translation: Discrimination on the basis of gender is prohibited.

sentences.text: Non bisognerebbe discriminare la gente in base al sesso.
sentences.translation: You should not discriminate against people based on their gender.

sentences.text: Il sito non sta funzionando per niente.
sentences.translation: The site isn't working at all.

sentences.text: Il suo sito web sembra buono.
sentences.translation: Your website looks good.

sentences.text: Chi ci guadagna dalla morte della vittima?
sentences.translation: Who gains by the victim's death?

sentences.text: Sono stato vittima dell'amore.
sentences.translation: I was a victim of love.

sentences.text: Ricordatevi l'anno scorso.
sentences.translation: Remember last year.

sentences.text: Avevo intenzione di farlo il mese scorso.
sentences.translation: I had intended to do that last month.

sentences.text: Non faccia tardi per il treno.
sentences.translation: Don't be late for the train.

sentences.text: Non venire a casa troppo tardi.
sentences.translation: Don't come home too late.

sentences.text: Agitare prima dell'uso.
sentences.translation: Shake before using.

sentences.text: Il vecchio orologio è ancora in uso.
sentences.translation: The old clock is still in use.

sentences.text: Perché imparare il francese?
sentences.translation: Why learn French?

sentences.text: Il fallimento è il modo migliore per imparare.
sentences.translation: Failure is the best way to learn.

sentences.text: Fa più danno che bene.
sentences.translation: It does more harm than good.

sentences.text: Ossigeno e idrogeno danno l'acqua.
sentences.translation: Oxygen and hydrogen make water.

sentences.text: Ho visto l'incontro di boxe in televisione.
sentences.translation: I saw the boxing match on television.

sentences.text: Incontro persone come lei ogni giorno.
sentences.translation: I meet people like you every day.

sentences.text: Faceva freddo e, inoltre, c'era vento.
sentences.translation: It was cold, and in addition, it was windy.

sentences.text: Inoltre il termine ha due utilizzi distinti.
sentences.translation: Moreover, the term has two distinct uses.

sentences.text: Non parlare così con mia sorella.
sentences.translation: Don't talk to my sister like that.

sentences.text: Come sta tua sorella oggi?
sentences.translation: How's your sister today?

sentences.text: Non abbiamo ancora chiuso l'affare.
sentences.translation: We haven't yet closed the deal.

sentences.text: Non è affare suo.
sentences.translation: It is not his business.

sentences.text: Insegna nella nostra scuola locale.
sentences.translation: She teaches at our local school.

sentences.text: Lavora come infermiera nell'ospedale locale.
sentences.translation: She works as a nurse in the local hospital.

sentences.text: La porta porta alla camera da letto.
sentences.translation: The door opens into the bedroom.

sentences.text: Mi trovavo nella mia camera d'ospedale.
sentences.translation: I was in my hospital room.

sentences.text: Non ha perso tempo a rispondere alla lettera.
sentences.translation: He lost no time answering the letter.

sentences.text: Sai scrivere una lettera in inglese?
sentences.translation: Do you know how to write a letter in English?

sentences.text: Assicurati di non essere seguito.
sentences.translation: Make sure you're not being followed.

sentences.text: Il cane mi ha seguito.
sentences.translation: The dog followed me.

sentences.text: Egli è forte e coraggioso, ma soprattutto gentile.
sentences.translation: He is strong, brave and, above all, kind.

sentences.text: Si rilassi e, soprattutto, non si faccia prendere dal panico.
sentences.translation: Relax, and above all, don't panic.

cards.gloss: to matter; to care (mi importa = I care); to import

sentences.text: A lui importa solamente di se stesso.
sentences.translation: He only cares about himself.

sentences.text: A me importa tanto di lei.
sentences.translation: I care about her very much.

sentences.text: Che fortuna incontrarla qui.
sentences.translation: How lucky to meet you here.

sentences.text: Il suo successo era in parte dovuto alla fortuna.
sentences.translation: His success was in part due to luck.

cards.gloss: to prepare; to make (a meal, a drink); to get ready

sentences.text: Andrò a preparare del tè.
sentences.translation: I'll go make tea.

sentences.text: Vai a preparare dei popcorn.
sentences.translation: Go make popcorn.

sentences.text: Non ho deciso io di essere gay.
sentences.translation: I didn't decide to be gay.

sentences.text: Non ho ancora deciso che cosa comprare.
sentences.translation: I still haven't decided what to buy.

sentences.text: Feci uno strano sogno.
sentences.translation: I had a strange dream.

sentences.text: Vivo il mio sogno.
sentences.translation: I'm living my dream.

sentences.text: Tieni il segreto, per favore.
sentences.translation: Keep the secret, please.

sentences.text: Mi dissero il loro segreto.
sentences.translation: They told me their secret.

sentences.text: Non parlo né il francese, né l'inglese.
sentences.translation: I speak neither French nor English.

sentences.text: Non bevo né caffè né tè.
sentences.translation: I drink neither coffee nor tea.

sentences.text: Tra moglie e marito non mettere il dito.
sentences.translation: Don’t interfere with a husband and wife.

sentences.text: Mio marito legge sempre a letto.
sentences.translation: My husband always reads in bed.

sentences.text: Questo suo romanzo è inferiore a quello precedente.
sentences.translation: This novel of his is inferior to the previous one.

sentences.text: Questo articolo è più interessante del precedente.
sentences.translation: This article is more interesting than the previous one.

cards.gloss: to mean, intend; to understand; to hear

sentences.text: Non intendevo mettervi in imbarazzo.
sentences.translation: I didn't mean to embarrass you.

sentences.text: Non intendevo niente di male.
sentences.translation: I meant no harm.

cards.gloss: to check, inspect; to control; to monitor, keep an eye on

sentences.text: Dovrò controllare con lei.
sentences.translation: I'll have to check with her.

sentences.text: Andrò a controllare.
sentences.translation: I'll go and check.

sentences.translation: Why not make it official?

sentences.text: Non è parte del piano ufficiale.
sentences.translation: That isn't part of the official plan.

sentences.text: È molto diretto a riguardo.
sentences.translation: He is very direct about it.

sentences.text: Solitamente è piuttosto diretto, vero?
sentences.translation: He's usually quite direct, isn't he?

sentences.text: Trascorsi l'intero fine settimana a casa al computer.
sentences.translation: I spent the whole weekend at home on the computer.

sentences.text: Avete letto il libro per intero?
sentences.translation: Did you read the whole book?

sentences.text: Conoscete l'orario di arrivo del suo aereo?
sentences.translation: Do you know the time of arrival of his plane?

sentences.text: Ti chiamerò appena arrivo a casa.
sentences.translation: I will give you a call as soon as I get home.

sentences.text: È il segretario privato del capo.
sentences.translation: He is the boss's private secretary.

sentences.text: Dovremmo discutere di questo in privato.
sentences.translation: We should discuss this in private.

cards.gloss: sack, bag; (informal) a lot, loads (un sacco di)

sentences.text: Portate il vostro pranzo al sacco.
sentences.translation: Bring your own picnic lunch.

sentences.text: Che c'è nel sacco?
sentences.translation: What's in the sack?

sentences.text: Non ho niente di particolare da dire adesso.
sentences.translation: I have nothing in particular to say now.

sentences.text: C'è qualcosa in particolare che volete imparare?
sentences.translation: Is there something in particular that you want to learn?

sentences.text: Potresti leggere questo per me?
sentences.translation: Could you read this for me?

sentences.text: Finisci di leggere il libro.
sentences.translation: Finish reading the book.

sentences.text: Sarà più utile nel lungo periodo.
sentences.translation: It's going to be more useful in the long run.

sentences.text: Odio essere da solo in questo periodo dell'anno.
sentences.translation: I hate being alone this time of year.

cards.gloss: that is, in other words; I mean

sentences.text: Incontrai tuo padre la settimana scorsa, cioè l'ultima settimana di giugno.
sentences.translation: I met your father last week, that is, the last week of June.

sentences.text: Arrivo alle otto, cioè tra un'ora.
sentences.translation: I'll arrive at eight, that is, in an hour.

sentences.text: Provo sempre a dire la verità.
sentences.translation: I always try to tell the truth.

sentences.text: Mi merito di sapere la verità.
sentences.translation: I deserve to know the truth.

sentences.text: Verrai a casa per cena stasera?
sentences.translation: Will you come home for dinner tonight?

sentences.text: Grazie per essere venuta stasera.
sentences.translation: Thank you for coming tonight.

cards.gloss: (impersonal) to be necessary; bisogna = one must, it is necessary to

sentences.translation: One must take care in whatever one does.

sentences.text: Bisogna mangiare per vivere. Non vivere per mangiare.
sentences.translation: You must eat to live. You must not live to eat.

sentences.text: Non andare là da solo.
sentences.translation: Don't go there by yourself.

sentences.text: Non li lascerò andare là.
sentences.translation: I won't let them go there.

sentences.text: A nome della società, ti do il benvenuto.
sentences.translation: On behalf of the company, I welcome you.

sentences.text: Di fatto è il presidente della società.
sentences.translation: He is the president of the company in fact.

sentences.text: Ero esattamente come te quando ero più giovane.
sentences.translation: I was exactly like you when I was younger.

sentences.text: Ho detto loro esattamente ciò che ho visto.
sentences.translation: I told them exactly what I saw.

sentences.text: Sogna mai di volare attraverso il cielo?
sentences.translation: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?

sentences.text: In qualche modo è riuscito a farsi strada attraverso l'università.
sentences.translation: Somehow he managed to work his way through college.

cards.gloss: maximum, greatest; (noun) the most, maximum (al massimo = at most)

sentences.text: Questo ci prenderà tre, al massimo quattro settimane.
sentences.translation: This will take us three, at most four weeks.

sentences.text: È stato superato il numero massimo di inviti.
sentences.translation: You have exceeded the maximum number of invites.

cards.gloss: to leave, depart; to set off; to start (off)

sentences.text: Il tuo treno parte dal binario dieci.
sentences.translation: Your train leaves from Platform 10.

sentences.text: Per piacere, ditegli di partire.
sentences.translation: Please tell him to leave.

cards.gloss: end; deadline, time limit; term, word

sentences.text: Il crimine non paga a lungo termine.
sentences.translation: Crime doesn't pay in the long run.

sentences.text: Il termine non mi è familiare.
sentences.translation: The word is unfamiliar to me.

cards.gloss: consideration, regard; care; (riguardo a) regarding, about

sentences.text: Niente riguardo a noi, senza di noi!
sentences.translation: Nothing about us, without us!

sentences.text: Non dirgli nulla riguardo al cavallo.
sentences.translation: Say nothing to him about the horse.

sentences.text: Qui ci si può avvicinare all'azione.
sentences.translation: Here, you can get close to the action.

sentences.text: L'uomo è nato per l'azione.
sentences.translation: Man is born for action.

sentences.text: Feci qualche chiamata.
sentences.translation: I made a few calls.

sentences.text: Come mi ha appena chiamata?
sentences.translation: What did you just call me?

sentences.text: A me manca davvero il mio ex.
sentences.translation: I really miss my ex.

sentences.text: È il tuo ex fidanzato, vero?
sentences.translation: He's your ex-boyfriend, isn't he?

cards.gloss: to grow; to increase, rise; (transitive) to raise, bring up

sentences.text: Non posso crescere nostro figlio da solo.
sentences.translation: I can't raise our child by myself.

sentences.text: In che tipo di ranch è cresciuto?
sentences.translation: What kind of ranch did you grow up on?

cards.gloss: pair; (un paio di) a couple of

sentences.text: Questo paio di scarpe non mi sta bene.
sentences.translation: This pair of shoes doesn't fit me.

sentences.text: Mi sono comprato un paio di scarpe.
sentences.translation: I bought myself a pair of shoes.

sentences.text: Ammetto il mio errore.
sentences.translation: I admit my mistake.

sentences.text: Non trovai alcun errore.
sentences.translation: I didn't find any mistakes.

cards.gloss: to offer; to treat (someone to something); (reflexive) to offer to do something

sentences.text: Si è offerta di fare il lavoro.
sentences.translation: She volunteered to do the job.

sentences.text: Non ci dovremmo offrire di aiutare?
sentences.translation: Shouldn't we offer to help?

sentences.text: Il tuo numero di stanza, per favore.
sentences.translation: Your room number, please.

sentences.text: Stanza in affitto.
sentences.translation: Room for rent.

sentences.text: Quanto per questo cappello rosso?
sentences.translation: How much for this red hat?

sentences.text: Ti sta bene il rosso.
sentences.translation: Red suits you.

sentences.text: Non mentire, tesoro.
sentences.translation: Don't lie, honey.

sentences.text: Ciao, mio tesoro.
sentences.translation: Hi, my darling.

cards.gloss: condition; state; (a condizione che) provided that

sentences.text: La farò a condizione di essere pagato.
sentences.translation: I will do it on condition that I am paid.

sentences.text: Accetterò il lavoro, a condizione che lei mi aiuti.
sentences.translation: I will accept the work, provided you help me.

sentences.text: All'interno della stanza c'è odore di fumo.
sentences.translation: Inside the room there is a smell of smoke.

sentences.text: Ora vediamo l'interno del castello.
sentences.translation: Now we see the interior of the castle.

sentences.text: Ci faccia vedere l'immagine.
sentences.translation: Show us the picture.

sentences.text: Mi piace l'immagine su questo barattolo.
sentences.translation: I like the picture on this jar.

sentences.text: Non guardarti mai indietro.
sentences.translation: Never look back.

sentences.text: Non mi lasciare indietro.
sentences.translation: Don't leave me behind.

sentences.text: Vivo nello spazio.
sentences.translation: I live in space.

sentences.text: Penso che questo tavolo occupi troppo spazio.
sentences.translation: I think this table takes up too much space.

sentences.text: Vado a dormire alle dieci quasi ogni giorno.
sentences.translation: I go to sleep at ten almost every day.

sentences.text: La sera vado a letto alle dieci.
sentences.translation: In the evening, I go to bed at ten.

cards.gloss: to save, rescue; to protect; (computing) to save

sentences.text: Grazie ancora per avermi salvato di nuovo.
sentences.translation: Thanks again for saving me once more.

sentences.text: Fui salvato dal mio cane.
sentences.translation: I was saved by my dog.

sentences.text: L'originale non è fedele alla traduzione.
sentences.translation: The original is unfaithful to the translation.

sentences.text: Legga la traduzione della canzone!
sentences.translation: Read the translation of the song!

sentences.text: Andata e ritorno oppure solo andata?
sentences.translation: Round trip or one-way?

sentences.text: Sta a te decidere se là ci andiamo oppure no.
sentences.translation: It's up to you to decide whether we'll go there or not.

cards.gloss: to explain; to spread out, unfold

sentences.text: Ora ti spiego tutto.
sentences.translation: I'll now explain everything.

sentences.text: Potresti spiegare il perché?
sentences.translation: Could you explain why?

sentences.translation: Here is a song from the first album.

sentences.text: Non sappiamo il testo della canzone.
sentences.translation: We don't know the lyrics.

sentences.text: Il povero bambino è nato sordo e muto.
sentences.translation: The poor child was born deaf and dumb.

sentences.text: Questo povero gatto è quasi morto di fame.
sentences.translation: This poor cat almost died of hunger.

cards.gloss: to close, shut; (of shops, offices) to close; to lock (chiudere a chiave)

sentences.text: Il cancello non era chiuso a chiave.
sentences.translation: The gate was unlocked.

sentences.text: Sai a che ora chiude il negozio?
sentences.translation: Do you know what time the shop closes?

sentences.text: Quale lingua si parla nel tuo paese?
sentences.translation: What language do they speak in your country?

sentences.text: Sai parlare più di tre lingue?
sentences.translation: Can you speak more than three languages?

sentences.text: Come sta tuo nonno?
sentences.translation: How is your grandfather doing?

sentences.text: Il ragazzo sta parlando con suo nonno.
sentences.translation: The boy is speaking to his grandfather.

sentences.text: Sono andata sulla scena del crimine.
sentences.translation: I went to the scene of the crime.

sentences.text: Non ero preparato per questa scena.
sentences.translation: I was not prepared for this scene.

sentences.text: Spero che vi piaccia il cibo piccante.
sentences.translation: I hope you like spicy food.

sentences.text: Non sprecare così tanto cibo.
sentences.translation: Don't waste so much food.

cards.gloss: to discover, find out; to uncover; to reveal

sentences.text: Andrò a vedere cosa riesco a scoprire.
sentences.translation: I'll go see what I can find out.

sentences.text: Prova a scoprire quando parte il treno.
sentences.translation: Try and find out when the train leaves.

sentences.text: Avevo una specie di cotta per lui.
sentences.translation: I sort of had a crush on him.

sentences.text: Molte specie sono in via di estinzione.
sentences.translation: Many species are endangered.

sentences.text: Il cliente vuole comprare il mio cane.
sentences.translation: The customer wants to buy my dog.

sentences.text: Il cliente non ha sempre ragione.
sentences.translation: The customer isn't always right.

sentences.text: Mi iscrivo volontariamente al Partito Comunista Cinese.
sentences.translation: I willingly join the Chinese Communist Party.

sentences.text: Da quanto tempo è partito l'autobus?
sentences.translation: How long ago did the bus leave?

sentences.text: Ci mandi più roba.
sentences.translation: Send us more stuff.

sentences.text: Come riesci a guardare questa roba?
sentences.translation: How can you watch this stuff?

sentences.text: Parlo per esperienza.
sentences.translation: I speak from experience.

sentences.text: Che grande esperienza!
sentences.translation: What a great experience!

sentences.text: Il sospetto ladro è ora sotto processo.
sentences.translation: The accused thief is on trial now.

sentences.text: Il processo non è aperto al pubblico.
sentences.translation: The trial is not open to the public.

cards.gloss: article (in a newspaper); (grammar) article; item, product

sentences.text: Grazie per l'articolo.
sentences.translation: Thank you for the article.

sentences.text: Quell'articolo è stato scritto in inglese.
sentences.translation: That article was written in English.

cards.gloss: to reach; to catch up with, join; to achieve, attain

sentences.text: Non li riesco a raggiungere.
sentences.translation: I can't reach them.

sentences.text: Si può raggiungere il parco da qualunque strada.
sentences.translation: You can reach the park by any road.

cards.gloss: blow, hit; shot (gunshot); shock; (fare colpo) to impress

sentences.text: Che colpo di fortuna!
sentences.translation: What a stroke of luck!

sentences.text: Sta cercando di fare colpo su di me?
sentences.translation: Are you trying to impress me?

sentences.text: Finalmente ho tutto quello di cui ho bisogno.
sentences.translation: I finally have everything I need.

sentences.translation: He attended the meeting as our company representative.

sentences.translation: I visited my father's grave.

sentences.translation: It's a secret I've decided to take to my grave.

sentences.translation: Are you for or against the bill?

sentences.translation: Are you for or against my plan?

sentences.translation: He has potential.

sentences.translation: I'll bring you up to date on the latest news from your city.

sentences.translation: I caught you.

sentences.translation: Because of the victory, he became a hero.

sentences.translation: Being determines consciousness.

sentences.translation: Can't you lift me?

sentences.translation: Can you help me lift this box?

sentences.translation: I entered into a collaboration with him.

sentences.translation: Thanks for taking her fishing.

sentences.translation: Where do you usually go fishing?

sentences.translation: There is no development without investment.

sentences.translation: This investment is risky.

sentences.translation: Circumstances do not allow me to say any more.

sentences.translation: The post office is half a mile away.

sentences.translation: It is two miles from here to the park.

sentences.translation: He turned to the president.

sentences.translation: I turned to him for advice.

sentences.translation: Where's the voting booth?

sentences.translation: He always walks with a rifle.

sentences.translation: Take my rifle.

sentences.translation: In the beginning, God created the universe.
